title: The "one line when the numbers match" test checks a helper no watch screen uses
what: A test proves that when today's target equals last time's numbers only one line shows, but it tests an old helper that no screen calls. The real screens always draw both a Previous and a Next line, so the same numbers show twice.
expected: The test should check the screen's own card, and the screen should show one line when the numbers match (or the journey should say two lines are wanted).
fix_line: Test the card the screens draw, decide one line or two, and remove the unused helper

title: The -15, +15 and Skip buttons on the watch rest timer have no test
what: No test changes a running rest by 15 seconds or skips it. The rule that a rest can never be cut below one second, and that a skipped rest does not come back or buzz, is unchecked.
expected: A test moves the rest by +15 and -15, checks the new end time and its floor, and checks Skip ends the rest with no later buzz.
fix_line: Add a small test of the rest step and skip rules

title: Only the bright countdown is size-checked at the largest text; weight, reps, the dim countdown and the smallest text are not
what: The text-size promise covers the countdown and the weight and reps numbers, bright and dim. Only the bright countdown is compared between normal and largest text. The weight and reps numbers, the dim countdown, the smallest text size and a live change of text size are never compared.
expected: Each big number is measured at normal, smallest and largest text, bright and dim, and must stay the same size.
fix_line: Extend the size comparison to the logging numbers, the dim screen and the smallest text

title: The watch's workout notice is never checked: its words, that it is silent, that only one shows
what: The notice that keeps MettleUp up during a workout is never posted in a test. Its two lines, its silent channel, that only one notice shows, and that it carries no exercise, weight or heart rate are unchecked. Tests only check when the app wants the notice.
expected: A test posts the notice and checks its words, that it makes no sound, that a second post replaces it, and that it holds nothing private.
fix_line: Add a small test that posts the notice and reads it back

title: Nothing tests that the watch asks for permissions only once; a test even pins the ask over a running rest
what: A test makes sure the heart-rate ask is chosen over a running rest timer when the ask flag is on. No test checks that the flag is cleared after the first answer, so a later open could cover a rest with the ask again.
expected: A test answers both asks, reopens the app and checks no ask screen comes back, during a rest or not.
fix_line: Add a test of the stored "already asked" mark

title: The "Phone not connected" screen's wait for two empty checks is never tested
what: Tests only check which screen shows once the phone is known to be gone. The rule that one empty check is not enough, and the return of the current set after the link is back, are unchecked, so a one-moment drop could flash the screen.
expected: A test feeds one empty check (no change) and then two (Phone not connected), then a link back with a new set.
fix_line: Add a test of the connection check count

title: When the watch writes its version for the phone is never tested
what: Tests check only which version values are kept. Writing once per change, writing again after an update or when the phone asks, and trying again after a failed write are unchecked.
expected: A test checks one write per process, a rewrite after an update or an ask, and no crash without Play services.
fix_line: Add a small test of when the version is written

title: No test taps the watch screen: the waking tap, the no-workout screen, the dim Open on phone button
what: No test checks that the first tap on a dimmed screen only wakes it and does not press Skip or -15, that the no-workout screen has no button and starts nothing, or that a dim Open on phone tap sends no second request. Only the crown's waking turn is tested.
expected: A screen test taps each of these and checks nothing else happens.
fix_line: Add screen tests for these three taps
